# Teamboard writing guide

Follow this guide for everything you write in this repository: help articles
(`help/`), release notes (`changelog/`), support replies (`support/`) and the
API reference (`api/`).

## Voice

Teamboard writes for busy team leads who want to get back to their work. Say
what to do and what happens next, in the fewest words that are still friendly.

- Plain, warm and direct. Neutral register, calm tone, no humor.
- Address the reader as "you". Active voice, short sentences, contractions
  where natural.
- Lead with the answer or the action, then the detail.
- Use sentence case in headings.
- Never promise an outcome Teamboard cannot control: describe what the
  product does and what the reader can do if something goes wrong.
- Do not mention other products by name; say "your previous tool" instead.

## Avoid

- Promises about reliability or data safety: "guarantee", "100% uptime",
  "never lose", "zero data loss", "always available".
- Exclamation marks.

## Words

| Write | Not |
| --- | --- |
| your previous tool | Boardly (a competitor; never name it) |
| email | e-mail |
| sign in (verb) | log in |
| sign-in (noun) | login |

## The Workspace rename

Workspaces were renamed Spaces in Teamboard 3.4. In everything a customer
reads (`help/`, `changelog/`, `support/`) write **Space**, never "Workspace".
The API reference (`api/`) keeps "workspace", because the endpoint names are
a published contract.
